question: Should live paired-node command identifiers remain operator/audit-only, or become eligible for model prompt projection?
rationale: Removing `prompt` is a narrow repair, but adding it to the shared contract would intentionally cross node-advertised identifiers into a model-facing trust and product boundary that this CLI slice does not review.

options.title: Keep operator-only visibility
options.body: Remove `prompt` here and evaluate model-facing exposure separately in the scoped command-prompt PR.

options.title: Approve prompt visibility
options.body: Expand the shared contract only after reviewing scope gates, sanitization, trust policy, and every downstream prompt consumer together.

recommendation.title: Keep operator-only visibility
recommendation.body: Remove `prompt` here and evaluate model-facing exposure separately in the scoped command-prompt PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway node-path ownership makes this the best available routing candidate, although the deeper history is ambiguous.
